question: Does a small regularized conditional BTC correction improve probability quality beyond a raw market reference and global market-only or market-plus-BTC logistic calibration?

source_artifacts.btc_prediction_source: A_frozen chronological development OOF predictions and frozen holdout model predictions from preopen_research_20261011_full_compute20_retry

sample.label: official Polymarket outcome only
sample_requirements: confirmed market and causal A_frozen prediction with fold provenance
official binary outcome released by the applicable development or holdout cutoff
valid causal two-sided T-60 quote under existing quote, source coverage, freshness, future-event, and book-gap checks
finite in-range p_market and p_BTC probabilities
all declared BTC candle features present and timestamp-aligned at T-60
features: BTC one-minute close-to-close return at decision candle
BTC five-minute close-to-close return at decision candle
BTC fifteen-minute close-to-close return at decision candle
sqrt(5)*population_std of the last 60 contiguous one-minute close-to-close returns, ddof=0
futures_index_basis_rel_1m on the candle closing at T-60
sample.btc_candle_alignment: The candle opened two minutes before market_start_utc and closed one minute before market_start_utc; its close is available at the T-60 decision time. Returns require contiguous valid positive closes; sigma requires 60 contiguous returns. No filling, clipping, or normalization is applied to returns.
sample.basis: Use existing futures_index_basis_rel_1m only; require full feature and candle-time coverage before training; do not collect new data.

chronological_cv.selection_score: mean fold binary log-loss + 0.5 * population standard deviation of fold binary log-loss
chronological_cv.fold_prediction_rows: All eligible labeled rows in the two fixed validation months; no random split.

conditional_correction.base_margin: logit_p_market via row-aligned init_score; external prediction is sigmoid(base_margin + raw tree correction), with the offset added exactly once
conditional_correction.search: Exactly six fixed configurations; no Optuna. One smoke fit on the first fold is checkpointed and reused as that configuration's first fold fit.
conditional_correction.stopping_metric: binary log-loss of sigmoid(row init_score + raw tree correction), evaluated externally each iteration
conditional_correction.final_iteration: floor of the median best iteration across the two chronological validation folds for the selected configuration

uncertainty.method: paired moving 3-day UTC blocks over chronological observations

budget.expected_model_fits: 12 conditional tree fold fits including the reusable smoke + 4 logistic benchmark fold fits + 3 frozen full-development fits; one holdout prediction/scoring pass
checkpoint_after: frozen development models before holdout scoring

holdout_use: One descriptive evaluation after all model, feature, and iteration choices are frozen. The July-October 2026 holdout was historically exposed. No procedure or policy changes after its results.
